```{r}
library(nlme)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

library(pharmaverseadam)
library(pharmaversesdtm)
library(admiral)
```


```{r load-data}
my_env <- new.env()

load("../Data/aht_trial1.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/aht_trial2.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/dapa_IV_oral.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/pain_relief.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/pain_score.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/sd_iv_rich_pkpd.rda", envir = my_env)
load("../Data/sd_oral_richpk.rda", envir = my_env)

loaded_names <- ls(my_env)
print(loaded_names) 

aht1 <- my_env[[loaded_names[1]]]   # Longitudinal two-arm PD data (SBP/DBP, biomarker + demographic covariates)
aht2 <- my_env[[loaded_names[2]]]   # Summary data from above (Changes from baseline to last obs.)
dapa <- my_env[[loaded_names[3]]]   # Crossover study, PK data (COBS)
painR <- my_env[[loaded_names[4]]]  # Longitudinal multi-arm PKPD (COBS, Pain Score/Pain Relief, no covariates other than dose)
painS <- my_env[[loaded_names[5]]]  # Summary data (NOT SAME AS ABOVE)
ivPKPD <- my_env[[loaded_names[6]]] # Longitudinal PKPD (COBS, EOBS + Dose and Demographic Covariates)
oralPK <- my_env[[loaded_names[7]]] # Longitudinal PK (conc, Dose and Demographic Covariates)


data("pc", package = "pharmaversesdtm")
data("ex", package = "pharmaversesdtm")
data("adsl", package = "pharmaverseadam") # Analysis Subject Level


pc <- pc %>% 
  filter(PCSEQ < 13) %>%
  group_by(USUBJID) %>%
  # Keep only subjects who have at least one non-NA, non-zero concentration record
  filter(any(!is.na(PCSTRESN) & PCSTRESN > 0)) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
dapa$COBS_adj <- pmax(dapa$COBS, 1e-4)
dapa <- dapa %>%
  arrange(ID, OCC, TAD) %>% # Global chronological sort first
  group_by(ID, OCC) %>%     # Group by subject and occasion
  mutate(
    # 1. Convert 0s to NA for both columns
    AMT_IV_clean = na_if(AMT_IV, 0),
    AMT_Oral_clean = na_if(AMT_ORAL, 0),
    
    # 2. Pick whichever route has the active dose at t = 0
    D_raw = coalesce(AMT_IV_clean, AMT_Oral_clean)
  ) %>%
  # 3. Propagate that initial dose down to all subsequent TAD rows
  fill(D_raw, .direction = "down") %>%
  # 4. Finalize D (defaulting to 0 if neither route was given)
  mutate(D = coalesce(D_raw, 0)) %>%
  # 5. Clean up temporary working columns
  select(-AMT_IV_clean, -AMT_Oral_clean, -D_raw) %>%
  ungroup()

dapa <- dapa %>% mutate(TADf = as.factor(TAD)) 
```


```{r dapa-models}
# dapaLin <- lmer(log(COBS_adj) ~ TAD + I(TAD^2)*OCC + AGE + WEIGHT + GENDER + (1 + TAD + I(TAD^2)|ID), 
#                 data=dapa)

dapaLin <- lme(COBS_adj ~ TADf*OCC + AGE + WEIGHT + GENDER,
               random = ~ (1 + TAD)|ID, data=dapa,
               control = lmeControl(maxIter = 200, msMaxIter = 200, opt = "optim"))

summary(dapaLin)
AIC(dapaLin)

dapa$predLin <- predict(dapaLin)
# dapa$predLin <- pmin(dapa$predLin, 10000)

# use NLMM from textbook for IV: Y = D/V exp{-(\theta_0 + \theta_1 Age_i)*t/V}
# need more parameters for Oral (Absorption)
dapaNL <- nlme(
  model = COBS ~ ifelse(
    FORMULATION == "IV",
    (D / V) * exp(-(theta1 + theta2 * AGE) * TAD / V),
    (F * D * ka / (V * (ka - (theta1 + theta2 * AGE) / V))) * 
      (exp(-((theta1 + theta2 * AGE) / V) * TAD) - exp(-ka * TAD))
  ),

  fixed = ka + F + theta1 + theta2 + V ~ 1,
  random = pdDiag(theta1 + theta2 + V ~ 1),
  groups = ~ ID,
  start = c(ka = 1.5, F = 0.8, theta1 = 1.2, theta2 = 0.01, V = 40.0),
  data = dapa
)

summary(dapaNL)
AIC(dapaNL)

dapa$predNL <- predict(dapaNL)

dapa$sqeLin <- (dapa$COBS_adj - dapa$predLin)^2
dapa$sqeNL <- (dapa$COBS_adj - dapa$predNL)^2
dapa$ss <- (dapa$COBS_adj - mean(dapa$COBS_adj))^2

rmseLin <- sqrt(mean(dapa$sqeLin))
rmseNL <- sqrt(mean(dapa$sqeNL))

r2Lin <- 1 - sum(dapa$sqeLin)/sum(dapa$ss) 
r2NL <- 1 - sum(dapa$sqeNL)/sum(dapa$ss) 

data.frame(Linear.Model = c(RMSE = rmseLin, R.squared = r2Lin), 
           NonLinear.Model = c(RMSE = rmseNL, R.squared = r2NL))


ggplot(data = dapa, aes(x = TAD, y = COBS)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(ID, OCC)), alpha = 0.4, color = "gray") + 
  # geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, color = "steelblue") + 
  stat_summary(aes(group=OCC, color=as.factor(OCC)), fun=mean, geom="line", linewidth=1.2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set2") +
  theme_minimal() +
```
